youtube.title: How Do You Feel? 😊😢 Feelings and Emotions for Kids | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
It's Bear's birthday party! Robo, Duck, Bear and Bunny meet five feelings in one day: happy, surprised, sad, angry and worried. All feelings are OK. Name the feeling, then pick a tool from Robo's calm-down toolbox: flower and bubble breathing, a hug, counting to five slowly, or telling a grown-up.

Try it at home with a grown-up: make feeling faces in a mirror, and practise flower and bubble breathing together (smell the flower, blow the bubble, three times, slowly).

A note for parents: if your child often feels very sad or worried, talk with someone you trust, like your child's doctor or teacher.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: How Do You Feel?
How Do You Feel?
A card! You are invited to Bear's birthday party!
A party! Quack, quack!
Look at Duck! How does Duck feel?
Happy! Let's go to the party.
happy
Happy birthday, Bear!
Thank you! I am so happy!
Everyone feels happy. How can we tell?
Bouncing! Wiggling! Big smiles!
Smiling uses muscles in your face!
Show me happy! Bounce, bounce!
happy
Bear, here is a gift for you!
Ooh. What is inside?
Oh! A pop-up star!
How does Bear feel?
Surprised! He jumped back and said oh!
surprised
Ha ha! I like surprises!
When you feel excited, your heart beats faster. Hand on your heart!
Show me surprised! Hands up. Oh!
Bear built a tall block tower.
Oh no. The tower fell down.
How does Bear feel?
Sad. How do we know?
sad
His head is down. He moves slowly.
It is OK to feel sad. Let's open the toolbox.
A heart. A hug can help. Bear, would you like a hug?
Yes, please.
Friends help. Let's build it again!
I feel sad. That's OK. A hug can help.
Bunny is playing with the red ball.
I want the red ball! Now!
How does Duck feel?
Angry! She is stomping her feet.
angry
It's OK to feel angry. It's not OK to hurt.
Let's open the toolbox.
Number five! Let's count to five, slowly.
One...
Two...
Three...
Four...
Five.
I feel calmer. Can I have a turn, please?
Yes! Let's take turns.
Thank you, Bunny!
I feel angry. That's OK. I count to five.
Now we sing a cheer for Bear!
Oh. I don't want to sing in front of everyone.
Bunny is hiding behind Robo. How does Bunny feel?
Worried. Let's open the toolbox.
worried
A house. Tell a grown-up how you feel.
Robo, I feel worried.
Thank you for telling me. We can sing together!
I feel worried. That's OK. I tell a grown-up.
Here is our calm-down toolbox.
A hug. Counting to five. Telling a grown-up.
And a flower, for flower and bubble breathing!
Smell the flower. Breathe in slowly.
Blow a bubble. Breathe out slowly.
Again. Smell the flower...
And blow the bubble.
Slow, deep breaths help your body feel calm.
calm
Name it, then pick a tool.
Feelings quiz! One. Duck is bouncing and wiggling. How does she feel?
Happy!
happy
Two. Bear's head is down. He moves slowly. How does he feel?
Sad!
sad
Three. Duck is stomping her feet. How does she feel?
Angry!
angry
Four. What can you do when you feel angry?
Count to five, or take slow breaths. Any tool can help!
Thank you, friends. You helped me so much!
Clap, clap, stomp! Hooray for Bear!
You are great feelings helpers!
All feelings are OK. Bye-bye!
